subject.title: feishu_doc `create` action silently ignores `content` parameter — creates empty document

question: Should `feishu_doc` create support initial `content` via an internal create-then-write sequence, or should create reject `content` and require the documented two-call workflow?
rationale: Source inspection proves the silent-drop path, but the permanent tool contract and write-failure recovery behavior are user-visible Feishu product decisions rather than a purely mechanical cleanup.

options.title: Support create-time content
options.body: Create the document, write supplied markdown through the existing write path, and preserve created metadata or roll back if the write step fails.

options.title: Reject content on create
options.body: Keep create title-only but fail clearly when callers provide `content`, with tests and docs pointing to create then write.

options.title: Use a separate action
options.body: Add a distinct create-with-content action only if maintainers want to keep create metadata-only while giving models a one-call path.

recommendation.title: Support create-time content
recommendation.body: Create the document, write supplied markdown through the existing write path, and preserve created metadata or roll back if the write step fails.

likelyOwner.reason: They have adjacent create-branch history and were already pulled into the prior create-with-content discussion.
